subject.title: Control UI fails to load on Firefox desktop behind reverse proxy — CSP blocks Vite runtime eval(), 'Control UI did not start', WebSocket 1006

question: Should maintainers keep this issue separate for the Firefox reverse-proxy WebSocket 1006 investigation while resolving the CSP/Zod work in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/78362, or fold this report into that existing thread?
rationale: The CSP evidence overlaps an open security-sensitive issue, but this report adds a distinct reverse-proxy socket failure that needs live proof before a gateway behavior change is safe.

options.title: Keep Separate Pending Live Proof
options.body: Keep this issue open for Firefox/nginx diagnostics while the strict-CSP Zod fix remains owned by the older CSP thread.

options.title: Fold Into CSP Thread
options.body: Treat the WebSocket 1006 as likely startup fallout from CSP and consolidate the discussion under the older issue.

options.title: Fix CSP First, Then Retest
options.body: Sponsor the strict-CSP Zod repair first, then ask for fresh reverse-proxy proof if the WebSocket failure remains.

recommendation.title: Keep Separate Pending Live Proof
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for Firefox/nginx diagnostics while the strict-CSP Zod fix remains owned by the older CSP thread.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest history across Control UI CSP, bootstrap config, and gateway connect behavior.
